root_cause.text: The rtw88 USB driver incorrectly acquires an additional reference to the USB device using `usb_get_dev` during probe initialization without releasing it on all error paths, causing a reference count leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows the removal of the `usb_get_dev(interface_to_usbdev(intf))` call in `rtw_usb_intf_init` and the corresponding `usb_put_dev(rtwusb->udev)` call in `rtw_usb_intf_deinit`, confirming the CVE description that the driver core already holds the reference while the interface is bound.

vuln_statements.explanation: Based on the root cause analysis, this usb_get_dev() call acquires an additional reference to the USB device during probe initialization. The vulnerability occurs because this reference is not released on all error paths - the deinit function (rtw_usb_intf_deinit) shown in the context does not contain a corresponding usb_put_dev() call to release the reference acquired by usb_get_dev(). This causes a reference count leak when probe fails after acquiring the reference.
